# BrainStore

> A human-readable, migration-safe knowledge store: plain files in, plain
> files out, every revision kept. Immutable revisions + per-path CAS HEAD.
> NOT an AI memory framework.

BrainStore is a self-hostable document store (local Rust server, or Cloudflare
Workers + R2 + D1) with an HTTP API, a Rust CLI and a web editor. Every save
writes an immutable blob + revision, then atomically swaps a per-path HEAD
pointer via compare-and-swap: two writers on the same base yield exactly one
200 and one 412. Deletes are tombstones; restores create new revisions; the
on-disk layout IS the backup; search indexes are rebuildable projections.

- Docs: [README](https://github.com/unic/brains/blob/main/README.md) ·
  [Runbook](https://github.com/unic/brains/blob/main/docs/runbook.md) ·
  [AI integration (agent API reference)](https://github.com/unic/brains/blob/main/docs/ai-integration.md) ·
  [Verification log](https://github.com/unic/brains/blob/main/docs/verification.md)
- Design spec (CN): brainstore-design/BrainStore-Architecture-v1.md
- Quickstart: `cargo build -p brainstore-server -p brainstore-cli` then
  `./target/debug/brainstore-server --data-dir ./brain-data --token "$TOKEN" --web-dist apps/web/dist`
  (first boot seeds template notes into the empty vault)
- CLI: `brainstore-cli ls | put | cat | rm | history | restore | search |
  links | patch | cp | mv | diff | reindex | export | seed`
- API surface: `/api/v1/*` — files, revisions, search (literal + FTS),
  links, restore, copy/move/diff, maintenance. See docs/ai-integration.md
  for the agent-facing reference with CAS etiquette.
- Deployment: GitHub Actions — tag `v*` → multi-platform release artifacts;
  `Deploy` workflow → Cloudflare Workers (secrets: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN,
  CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; R2 bucket brainstore-data; D1 database
  brainstore-index).
